newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA PEACE CALL AFTER VERBAL WAR WITH REAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA PEACE CALL AFTER VERBAL WAR WITH REAL.

text.p: Barcelona have attempted to play down the acrimony between their president Jose Luis Nunez and Real Madrid counterpart Lorenzo Sanz which followed Saturday's league clash between the two major rivals.
Nunez and Sanz insulted each other in separate interviews in the wake of Barcelona's ill-tempered 1-0 victory.

"In the moments of tension that are lived in a game of this magnitude there are isolated words that could be considered offensive, but it should not be necessary to give them importance out of context," said part of a Barcelona statement on Monday.
Real have not yet replied but Sanz has refused to return to Barcelona's Camp Nou stadium.
